artifact_record_rules.path: project-relative or B4G-phase-relative existing regular file
artifact_record_rules.replay_type: must equal the frozen parent-to-replay-type map

replay_bundle.canonical_json: UTF-8 sorted compact separators comma-colon, allow_nan false, LF terminal newline
replay_bundle.artifact_records_rule: must contain the exact EXECUTION_SOURCE_MANIFEST plus at least one distinct non-manifest raw campaign, contract, frozen fixture or executed harness source; every record must exist and byte-match, paths must be unique, and canonical inventory SHA must equal execution_provenance.underlying_artifact_inventory_sha256

nominal_payload_derivation.authority: b4g_validation/artifact_derivation.py independently rebuilds every nominal payload from the byte-bound artifact_records without importing b4g_solver, b4g_execution, run_phase_b4g_solver.py or run_phase_b4g_mutation_audit.py
nominal_payload_derivation.acceptance_rule: base.payload canonical JSON bytes must equal the independently derived nominal payload exactly; a valid-looking payload, receipt flag or random SHA without the exact artifacts fails closed
nominal_payload_derivation.mutant_acceptance_rule: mutant.payload canonical JSON bytes must equal the independently derived preregistered mutant for the exact parent_id and 1-based subvariant_index; the validator derives both mutation target and amplitude from frozen contracts plus byte-bound raw artifacts
nominal_payload_derivation.coordinated_forgery_rule: a coordinated base plus patch plus mutant rewrite, including one that still kills the expected Gate, fails unless both the nominal and the preregistered mutant are independently artifact-derived
nominal_payload_derivation.base_mutant_common_fields_rule: base and mutant bundles must be identical in every top-level field except payload; the restricted patch must be the sole transformation

independent_checks: event-acquisition initial state and native z-plus binding
active target, gap and rate reconstruction from service state plus immutable acquisition snapshot
every active and post stage 2x2 centered P-gap Jacobian, opening sign, command and power
sample momentum drift, energy-minus-work and signed-work trapezoidal quadrature
piecewise cubic Hermite all-root earliest bilateral dwell removal
componentwise removal mapping with raw impulse and kinetic jump cross-check
independent post target/gap/rate/clearance/contact and parent cross-check
derived NC07, NC08 and NC11-NC14 source payloads
finite_raw_replay.top_precondition_rule: the evidence finite_event_harness_precondition must equal the validator reconstruction exactly, including finite event, signed and absolute work, removal time, post pass and all no-credit fields

authoritative_supplemental_raw_artifacts.acceptance_rule: the listed role is a required hash-bound artifact in both base and mutant bundles; execution_detail cannot substitute, and every reported branch or outcome is independently recomputed

MUTANT_DWELL_FORCE_TRACE.complete_propagation_rule: require the exact event-to-one-step-past-nominal-removal frozen time grid; fresh event configuration plus acquisition eta_plus and exact zero initial work; complete RK4 or midpoint stage label/code/time pattern; every stored stage state/Q/power exact to its raw sample; positive mass diagnostics; nonstatic selected P velocity response; terminal no-removal/no-domain-exit semantics
MUTANT_DWELL_FORCE_TRACE.ledger_rule: require all 16 frozen sample ledgers, independently recompute linear/angular drift and energy-minus-work from raw arrays, enforce closed thresholds and exact-zero active contact arrays
MUTANT_DWELL_FORCE_TRACE.rule: bind the nominal finite clearance interval to EXECUTED_FINITE_HARNESS_RAW_OUTPUT; from the complete forced_run_to_raw samples, stages and ledgers independently rebuild the frozen branched mass/bias, attached-target reduction, patched force, Cholesky RHS, RK4 or midpoint tableau, every accepted and internal-stage state, target, momentum, kinetic energy, signed work, all 16 full/reduced ledgers, geometry, diagonal derivatives, exact-zero contact and selected nonzero P-side dwell force; a coordinated fabricated trajectory, static state, empty ledger, shortened grid, fabricated stored stage, diagonal drift or nonzero contact fails closed

A2_DETECTOR_SIX_LANE_TRACE.branch_authority: the independently validated official campaign summary selector is authoritative: selected_parent_level null requires this fallback role and forbids the executed-A2 role set; a non-null selected parent forbids this role and requires CAMPAIGN_SUMMARY plus 24 official A2 metadata artifacts
A2_DETECTOR_SIX_LANE_TRACE.rule: the no-parent fallback is an algorithm-only symmetric detector harness, never a B3 dynamics run: require six lanes times six traces on each frozen step through exactly 0.08 s; independently reconstruct command_for_slot and force_vector Q, symmetric rate=mobility*Q, trapezoidal gap/work histories and no-credit outcome; production-equivalent direct mirror comparison must give PASS for both base pairs and FAIL only after the registered 0.75 or 0.25 right-side mutation

GEOMETRY_CLIP_EXTRAPOLATE_TRACE.nonnull_rule: no_domain_guard_evaluation is null for SV01-SV04 and is the complete exact-field object for SV05 clipping and SV06 extrapolation
GEOMETRY_CLIP_EXTRAPOLATE_TRACE.rule: bind state and acquisition snapshot to the registered case; independently reproduce the raw frozen DomainExit; for SV05 and SV06 require the actually executed mutation-only no-domain-guard B601 6R+2P pad/attached-target FK, nominal gap/rate, complete centered plus/minus probes and 2x2 Jacobian; reject clipping/extrapolation by policy even when the diagnostic equations are finite; this evaluator never supplies selector, scientific, physical, or current-system credit

patch_artifact.pointer_rule: RFC6901 escapes are limited to ~0 and ~1; list indices are canonical unsigned decimal without leading zero, negative indices are forbidden, and '-' is valid only for list append by add
patch_artifact.replay_rule: apply operations in order to parsed base bundle; canonical JSON result must equal the parsed mutant bundle and its canonical bytes plus LF must equal the mutant artifact bytes

receipt_replay_binding.frozen_each_receipt_requires_resolution: the frozen names actual_failed_gate, nominal_gate_sha256 and mutant_gate_sha256 are satisfied only in the validator-generated augmented receipt records; they are forbidden in the unaudited executor evidence to avoid circular self-attestation
receipt_replay_binding.rule: gate records, actual failed gate and gate-record hashes are generated only by the read-only validator and emitted in its validation report observations

semantic_patch_rules.target_authority: validator independently rebuilds the exact RFC6902 pointer or ordered pointer list from frozen parent_id plus 1-based subvariant_index; receipt and patch target must both equal it
semantic_patch_rules.operation_authority: all operations are replace except the two NC16 schedule append operations, which are add; operation order and count must exactly equal the rebuilt target list
semantic_patch_rules.value_authority: frozen scalar/list values and every trajectory-derived mutant value are independently rebuilt; exact frozen paths plus an independently rejected Gate are necessary but do not substitute for canonical equality to the artifact-derived preregistered mutant

nc09_nc10_classifier_trace.history_rule: exact corresponding hash-bound frozen canonical fixture; history and ledger are not mutable

independent_replay_acceptance.nominal_gate_sha256: SHA-256 of validator canonical base gate record
independent_replay_acceptance.mutant_gate_sha256: SHA-256 of validator canonical mutant gate record

independent_gate_record_exact_schema.hash_rule: uppercase SHA-256 of UTF-8 sorted compact canonical JSON without terminal newline

structured_source_binding.supplemental_role_record_rule: sorted by receipt_id then role and conditional on the independently validated official selector: no-parent fallback has exactly ten bindings (two NC08, two NC17 references to one shared six-lane artifact, six NC21); selected-parent executed-A2 has exactly eight bindings (two NC08 and six NC21, with no NC17 supplemental); every path is the canonical project-relative formal path
structured_source_binding.inventory_hash_rule: canonical SHA256 of receipt_count, sorted base/mutant/patch SHA lists and sorted supplemental_role_records before adding inventory_sha256

claim_boundary: mutation replay evidence only; no A1/A2 outcome, physical, current-system, formal NC19, Owner, production, release or next-stage credit
